description:
Will a short sale hurt your credit? The answer might surprise you.

Worried about your credit if you sell your home?

A short sale can impact your credit — but for many homeowners, it’s often less damaging long-term than foreclosure.

The biggest factor? Timing.

The earlier you understand your options, the more control you may have over the outcome.
